title.zh: 启动执行生命周期策略

descriptions.zh:
启动执行生命周期策略。
仅 CPFS 智算版文件系统的生命周期管理策略中 LifecyclePolicyType 为 OnDemand 时支持。
descriptions.en: This operation is supported only when the `LifecyclePolicyType` of a lifecycle policy is set to `OnDemand` for a CPFS AI-Computing Edition file system.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun nas start-lifecycle-policy-execution --file-system-id bmcpfs-00150000 --lifecycle-policy-id lc-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
